headline: Executive order creates a White House task force focused on the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House task force about the 2026 FIFA World Cup soccer tournament, which the United States is co-hosting. No summary was provided, so details about who is on the task force and what exact duties it has are not covered here. Based on the title, its role appears to be organizing the federal government's work related to the event.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies may be asked to take part in or work with the new task force on World Cup planning.

who_it_affects.group: US cities hosting World Cup matches
who_it_affects.how: Host cities may work with the task force as the federal government plans for the tournament.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 7, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
